channel.title: The Mendocino Voice - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Mendocino Voice (mendovoice.com)

item.title: All truckers and bus drivers will be required to take commercial driver’s license tests in English
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the change is part of a broader effort to improve safety and crack down on unqualified drivers and fraudulent schools.

item.title: Negie Fallis charged with four felonies in Covelo shooting
item.description: Fallis, a person of interest in the 2018 disappearance of Khadijah Britton, faces attempted murder and other charges tied to a November shooting.

item.title: Furious with Trump, California Democrats plot election strategy in San Francisco
item.description: In a pivotal election year that will serve as a referendum on the second Trump administration, California Democrats face pressure from activists on the left to abandon “radical civility” and instead back candidates who will push back hard against the GOP.

item.title: One person found in vehicle pulled from Eel River
item.description: The victim was identified as Gary Niesen of Covelo by family on social media. The search for his wife, Yvonne, continues.

item.title: Bill would shift focus of state demonstration forests from logging to restoration
item.description: Assembly Bill 2494 would make research, restoration and recreation the primary purposes of the state’s 14 working forests, including Jackson Demonstration State Forest.

item.title: Wednesday’s Fort Bragg Meet & Greet focused on conversation, not speeches
item.description: Police Chief Eric Swift and City Manager Isaac Whippy encouraged a free flow of ideas from residents concerned about youth opportunities, housing, immigration enforcement, racism and more.

item.title: To aficionados, fungi are freaky, mystical and overlooked. They’re helping scientists learn more
item.description: Scientists say fungi play a critical role in ecosystems and the global economy, but conservation efforts lag as climate change and habitat loss threaten largely undocumented species.

item.title: James Schnitzius selected to lead Mendocino County DA’s Bureau of Investigations
item.description: The veteran law enforcement official will assume chief investigator role March 1 following Andrew Alvarado’s retirement.

item.title: Licensed 20-acre cannabis farm near Upper Lake for sale
item.description: Realtor promises 'Grow Big, Profit Fast’ on a farm with lots of infrastructure.

item.title: Photos: Winter storm turns Mendocino County into a snow-covered landscape
item.description: Reader-submitted images show snowy scenes (with a touch of hail) from across Mendocino County.
